question: For the first feasible chained Boolean systems at arity five and six, do the three fixed four-draw UNSAT packages refute under fixed-degree MutantXL closure by degree four while the fixed six-draw SAT package remains unrefuted?

claims.text: Each of the three registered four-draw cell packages receives one exact bounded-four, above-four, draw-dependent, unmeasured, or invalid classification, conditional on the six-draw satisfiable package and one-draw identity package.
claims.if_supported: Advance bounded cells to growing ell and n, matched external F4, and complete charged cost; retain every other presentation and scale question as open.
claims.if_not_supported: A validated above-four row rejects only universal closure degree four at its exact completed cell; resource-censored work remains unmeasured, invalid evidence yields no scientific conclusion, and degree five and other formulations remain live.

claims.text: No elapsed-time, throughput, end-to-end ECDLP, asymptotic, or cryptographic-scale claim is in scope.

aa.not_applicable_reason: No clock, throughput, or relative-performance quantity is a metric; all decisions use exact algebraic replay and completion states.

positive.expected_detection: Each of exactly six expected control objects matches its registered cell/draw, retains a positive exact solution count, contains exactly the saturated degree-3 and degree-4 scan rows with measured_to=4, and reports neither XL nor closure refutation. A process that claims success but emits a duplicate, missing-degree, missing, malformed, or contradictory final object invalidates the package; an explicitly recognized resource interruption with no claimed success is unmeasured and does not suppress candidate execution.

negative.not_applicable_reason: The exactly-unsatisfiable systems are the registered scientific instances, not a sampled null population; their zero solution counts are checked before closure.

factors.name: source_build_and_caps
factors.value: One frozen commit, container digest, compiler, three scientific release binaries, and one publication release binary; four threads; degree four; 400000 columns; 32 GB address space.
factors.how: The runner compares Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, build.rs, root src/**, the three instrument examples, the report example, this runner, and sources.sha256 to the registered source commit; sources.sha256 additionally binds its enumerated files. Exact release-binary hashes, container/compiler identity, sanitized environment, argv, protocol hash, and manifests are checked before every executable stage. Cargo path-dependency trees require the full checkout but are not independently claimed as enumerated source coverage; the byte-identical frozen binaries are authoritative for executed code.

factors.name: draw_stream
factors.how: Three separate deterministic native generator calls, one per cell, retain the full strictly increasing unique draw-index prefix until both quotas are met. Before installation and before every use, a separate native audit mode replays the exact seed-derived RNG stream and recomputes every scientific field, including basis, target, exact solution count, and outcome, while excluding timing only. Each generation sidecar binds JSONL and generator-log SHA256, byte length, record count, and audit argv. Selection is numeric, never file-order or closure-outcome dependent.

factors.name: composite_evidence_packages
factors.value: Five export rows: one identity package (1 subprocess), one SAT package (6 subprocesses), and three cell-specific UNSAT packages (4 subprocesses each).
factors.how: The native analyzer retains and audits all 19 underlying subprocess histories, then emits exactly one deterministic logical row per package; a package is never represented by an arbitrary constituent subprocess.

factors.name: scientific_environment
factors.how: Every closure replay uses the exact allowlist. Inherited KIC_F4_*, KIC_GF2_*, F4_F2_*, tuning, debug, and thread variables are absent; the attempt metadata records the complete child environment.

factors.name: host
factors.how: Attempt metadata records CPU model, logical CPU count, memory bytes, kernel, and architecture; the sanitized environment separately fixes the four-thread scientific setting. No hypervisor or placement identity is claimed. These facts cannot license a timing claim.

factors.name: execution_order
factors.value: identity, satisfiable controls, then cells in listed order and ascending numeric draw index
factors.how: The runner admits only the next registered logical step: identity; six controls in listed-cell and ascending-draw order; then twelve candidates in listed-cell and ascending-draw order. Each detached job runs exactly one closure subprocess. Identity/control steps must reach a terminal state before candidates begin. A contradictory or malformed terminal identity/control record stops execution; a resource-unmeasured terminal control does not suppress candidate work, although it withholds package conclusions.

factors.name: checkout_and_durable_state
factors.value: Full repository checkout at an exact pushed descendant of the registered source commit; output root is exactly the absolute EPHEMERAL_OUT path.
factors.how: Path-dependency and build closure require the whole checkout, not a sparse path set. DREG_EXECUTION_REF must be a fully qualified refs/heads/... name whose live git ls-remote origin OID equals HEAD. After an attempt stops and before transport snapshots its output, seal-resume-anchor writes the exact immutable manifest create-new to absolute DREG_RESUME_ANCHOR_OUT outside the output root and repository. Transport retains that sidecar independently. On resume, EPHEMERAL_RESUME_DIR is copied into an initially empty EPHEMERAL_OUT and deterministic source/destination manifests must match; DREG_RESUME_ANCHOR must name the independently retained ordinary file outside both roots and repository and be byte-identical to the recomputed immutable-source manifest. A v3 import record binds copy, immutable, and anchor descriptors before any new attempt. Checkout-local output is refused on detached workers.

instance_sampling.rule: Each arm is one fixed composite package. The three candidate packages use the first four exact zero-solution records of their cell; the positive package uses the first two exact positive-solution records of each cell; the identity package contains only m4,n12,ell5,draw24. Draw selection is by ascending numeric index in an audited committed full prefix and fails if either cell quota is unavailable by draw 4095.

blinding.how: All outcomes are exact and the complete fixed sample is reported; no analyst choice or inferential comparison is present.

power.note: This is a finite exact classification of five registered composite packages, not a population-frequency or significance claim. The 19 underlying closure subprocesses remain individually visible in the analyzer summary.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: Per-job admission budget only. Each detached job executes exactly one of 19 closure subprocesses and is separately capped at 24 hours; the three generator invocations are separate prerequisite jobs. No elapsed-time result is analyzed.

primary.name: Exact closure outcome
primary.definition: For an audited exactly-unsatisfiable draw: closure_le_4 only when one completed degree-3 or degree-4 row refutes; above_4 only when exactly one final object has no XL/closure refutation, measured_to=4, and a completed saturated degree-4 row. An explicit cap, timeout 124 (timeout), corrupt/malformed/wrong-system checkpoint 125 (checkpoint_invalid), SIGKILL/OOM or timeout-kill 137 (signal_kill), checkpoint TERM 143 (signal_term), exact Rust allocator-failure address-space event at 134 (address_space), or exhausted infrastructure-only retry budget is unmeasured. A process that claims success but has a missing, duplicate, malformed, wrong-draw, or contradictory final object is invalid, as is a deterministic assertion, panic, unrecognized signal, or other unrecognized nonzero exit. Early completed refutation does not require a later degree-4 row.
primary.source: runs/unsat-*/attempts/* retained stdout/status/meta plus native summary.json

primary.name: Refuted satisfiable controls

A claimed-success duplicate, missing, malformed, or contradictory object invalidates the package; a recognized resource-censored non-success is unmeasured and withholds, but does not falsify, the shared gate.

stopping_rules.rule: Run three restartable generator jobs, one deterministic stream per cell with --unsat 4 --min-sat 2. Each writes temporary JSONL and log files, records their SHA256 and byte lengths in a generation sidecar, and invokes the frozen native replay mode to regenerate the exact seed stream and compare every scientific field except timing before atomically installing them. A validated existing cell is skipped; an invalid partial is retained and generation fails. Select exactly the first four exact UNSAT plus first two exact SAT records by numeric draw index; never replace the seed or select by closure outcome.

Run one logical closure subprocess per detached job in the fixed registered order. The identity replay and all six satisfiable controls must each reach a terminal record before the twelve UNSAT scans. Any algebraic identity mismatch, claimed-success malformed/duplicate/missing control, deterministic instrument failure, or refuted satisfiable control invalidates interpretation and stops primary execution. A terminal resource-unmeasured identity/control does not suppress any candidate scan; it keeps every conditional package conclusion unmeasured until that shared gate is measured successfully.

Each process is limited to 400000 columns, 32 billion address-space bytes, four threads, and 86400 seconds, with 60 seconds after TERM and at most four append-only attempts. A completed degree-3 or degree-4 refutation is closure_le_4. Above_4 requires no refutation, measured_to=4, and a present saturated degree-4 row. An explicit cap object, timeout 124 (timeout), corrupt/malformed/wrong-system checkpoint 125 (checkpoint_invalid), SIGKILL/OOM or timeout-kill 137 (signal_kill), checkpoint TERM 143 (signal_term), exact Rust allocator-failure address-space event at 134 (address_space), or recognized infrastructure interruption is unmeasured, never above-four and never a disproof; it remains pending before attempt four and becomes terminal unmeasured at attempt four. A claimed-success attempt with a malformed, duplicate, missing, wrong-draw, missing-required-degree, or contradictory final object is invalid for every role. A deterministic assertion, panic, unrecognized signal, or other unrecognized nonzero exit is invalid rather than infrastructure-censored.

Never overwrite a committed attempt. Allocate runs/<logical-name>/attempts/<NNNN> with an atomic dreg.high-arity-allocation/v1 allocated.json marker, retain stdout and stderr, atomically install complete metadata, status, and finished records for every invocation, reuse only the logical run's shared manifest-validated checkpoint, and write a final pointer only after the frozen native analyzer classifies the full history. A final directory containing only its valid allocation marker and recognized setup temporaries is reused and does not consume one of four attempts; metadata or process evidence commits it to the retry count. A leftover setup temporary without process evidence is retryable and cannot become invalid scientific evidence.

The entire campaign has a USD 20.00 ceiling, one build attempt, at most three generator attempts, at most 76 closure attempts (19 first attempts plus at most 57 retries), concurrency one, a 16-vCPU/64-GiB worker ceiling, and an original absolute deadline of 2026-12-01T00:00:00Z. Build, queue/idle, successful, failed, interrupted, Spot-restart, storage, checkpoint, and transfer costs all charge the same ledger. Unknown or insufficient account-budget or lane-ledger headroom stops submission. No build or job may start until the exact code, frozen protocol, binary/source manifests, launch-request configuration and command are committed and pushed, GitHub custody is verified and retained, the correct authorized account is active, and every blocker in launch-request.json is cleared. A budget or custody stop leaves every affected mathematical question open and unmeasured.

invalidation_rules: Any mismatch in the historical identity replay's algebraic fields invalidates the new cells until explained and a new protocol version is filed before rerun.
Any satisfiable control refuted by XL or closure invalidates that cell and the shared instrument; no primary conclusion is allowed.

A draw file generated before the protocol freeze, not reproduced field-for-field by the frozen native replay mode, not bound with its generator log by the generation-sidecar hashes, or altered after its commit is inadmissible.
A resumed run whose wall time is interpreted as evidence is inadmissible; exact counters remain usable after manifest-validated restore.

A checkpoint generation whose canonical manifest does not uniquely hash exactly every ordinary generation file including catalog.json, or whose spec_sha256 differs from the hashed catalog system identity, is checkpoint_invalid and supplies no scientific result.

A claimed-success row whose checkpoint_segments field is missing or differs from its selected attempt's validated checkpoint_restore metadata (exactly one segment when fresh, at least two when restored) is invalid.

Any executable stage whose HEAD does not equal the live origin OID of its fully qualified DREG_EXECUTION_REF, whose registered source commit is not an ancestor, whose enumerated instrument, report, or runner paths differ from that commit, or whose clean-tree, image/compiler, binary, or sanitized-child-environment identity fails is inadmissible.

Any detached run whose output root is not exactly the absolute EPHEMERAL_OUT path, or whose prior EPHEMERAL_RESUME_DIR tree was not copied into an initially empty new output root with matching deterministic source/destination manifests, a byte-identical independently retained DREG_RESUME_ANCHOR sealed before transport outside both roots and the repository, and a retained v3 import record before execution, is inadmissible.
Any closure subprocess executed out of the fixed identity, listed-control, then listed-cell/ascending-draw candidate order is inadmissible.

Any overwritten attempt, lost retry, nonnumeric draw selection, duplicate draw index, skipped stream record, unexpected cell/shape, contradictory outcome/solution count, or status-only completion decision invalidates the affected package.

Any cloud build or job submitted without the pushed exact launch request, finite cost/resource/deadline/retry budget, GitHub publication-check receipt, reconciled request identity, correct authorized AWS account, and verified unreserved budget headroom is operationally inadmissible and supplies no scientific evidence.

Any publication summary that is not byte-identical to an immediate fresh execution of the frozen analyzer over the retained evidence is inadmissible; the publisher must also rederive and validate row, cell, package, and global consistency before rendering.

decision_rule.text: The frozen native analyzer audits all append-only attempts and emits exactly five logical package rows. For an UNSAT draw, closure_le_4 requires a completed refutation at degree 3 or 4; above_4 requires no refutation plus measured_to=4 and a saturated degree-4 row; recognized resource censoring is unmeasured, while claimed-success malformed/missing/duplicate/contradictory evidence or deterministic instrument failure is invalid. Candidate subprocesses still run after a resource-unmeasured shared gate, and every valid candidate row remains visible. Identity and all six controls must pass before a cell package receives a scientific bounded-four, draw-dependent, or not-universally-four classification; a resource-unmeasured gate therefore leaves the package unmeasured, while an invalid gate makes interpretation invalid. Conditional on passed gates, four closure_le_4 rows give bounded-four; a fully measured mixture gives draw-dependent; otherwise any valid above_4 row rejects universal four at that cell even if another UNSAT row is merely unmeasured; absent such a counterexample, any unmeasured constituent makes the package unmeasured. Invalid resume-import custody yields invalid_instrument and must remain publishable as an invalid/no-conclusion campaign when frozen provenance is sound; unavailable or invalid frozen protocol/source/binary provenance is untrusted and cannot be published.
decision_rule.threshold: Five audited composite rows backed by all 19 retained closure subprocess histories: four classified UNSAT draws per cell, six sound SAT controls, and exact identity replay
decision_rule.statistic: Exact count of closure-by-four versus complete-no-refutation outcomes among four fixed draws per cell
decision_rule.interval: No sampling interval; finite exact registered draws only
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Exact closure degree category and instrument counters per completed draw; no standardized or timing effect size

graphs: Per-subprocess exact outcomes for all 19 registered rows, with resource-unmeasured and invalid rows visible and no timing axis

inadmissible: Calling timeout, OOM, cap, missing output, incomplete degree, or checkpoint corruption a failure of the mathematical mechanism
Generalizing three toy cells to constant degree at cryptographic scale or to another presentation
Using emitted seconds for a speed, scaling, or comparative claim
Hiding an extra draw, control failure, interrupted row, retry, or resume
Changing the seed, draw selection, cap, degree, or cell after seeing closure output
Treating process exit zero, a nonempty stdout file, a final pointer, or a self-consistent edited summary as a scientific classification without a byte-identical fresh frozen-analyzer replay
Treating an assertion, panic, or unrecognized nonzero exit as resource censoring, or treating a claimed-success malformed, duplicate, or missing final object as merely unmeasured
Suppressing candidate execution solely because a shared identity or satisfiable-control attempt is resource-censored; shared gates condition interpretation, not pursuit
Collapsing, overwriting, or omitting any of the 19 subprocess histories or any retry attempt when producing the five logical package rows
Launching a monolithic multi-draw detached job, a sparse checkout, an unpushed ref, a non-durable output root, or an inherited solver environment
Closing GG14, FGHR, symmetric, topology-dependent, degree-five, or end-to-end index-calculus leads from this experiment
